summary: Comprehensive architectural blueprint and implementation plan for JobSentry (FakeJobScanner). Outlines the Node.js Express full-stack architecture, zero-fallback shared Zod/TypeScript contracts, two-stage environment configurations (staging & production), strict anti-AI slop 3-color palette (obsidian black, crisp white, subtle zinc gray), interactive animated grid/text reveal system, and the accompanying production-grade architecture contract document.
